description: The signed-in couple's own wedding budget on Zola: change the title, the estimate, the actual cost or the note of 1 budget item. Get the item_id and its version from zola_get_my_budget first. A field that the call does not give keeps its value. The cost of the item is the actual cost when it has one, else the estimate. With a booked vendor, the item and the vendor get the same price: the preview shows both. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

actual_cost_cents.description: The new actual cost, in cents. 0 clears the actual cost, except for an item with a booked vendor that has a price. With a booked vendor, the price of the vendor changes too

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

note.description: The new note. An empty text clears the note

title.description: The new title of the item

version.description: The version of the item from zola_get_my_budget. A change of the item after that read stops the preview

name: zola_update_my_budget_item

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a change of a budget item of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the budget

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_budget_item with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The budget items with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_get_my_budget gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

removal_count.description: the changes that overwrite a value

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Update My Budget Item
